label: Bible Study
prompt: _____, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
note: A wake-up call for Zion — the light has come, so get up and shine.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at _____.
verse: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
note: Five short words of comfort: The Lord is at hand — near in time, and near right now.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe _____. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
verse: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
note: Baby Moses cried at the perfect moment — and the princess's heart melted, even knowing he was a Hebrew child.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Jabez was more _____ than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verse: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
note: Jabez was named for his mother's painful birth, yet he stands out in a long list of names as the one who prayed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of _____ springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
verse: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
note: A 'root of bitterness' springs up and defiles many — Hebrews borrowing an image from Deuteronomy 29:18.
